I can help with questions about needs, wants, saving, budgeting rules, goals, income, expenses, and overspending.
A need is something essential, like food, rent, transport, books, or utilities.
A want is something optional, like snacks, games, streaming, or fashion.
Try to save at least 20 percent of your income each month.
The 50-30-20 rule: 50 percent needs, 30 percent wants, 20 percent savings.
Budgeting means planning how you spend. Start with your income, then split it into needs, wants, and savings.
To avoid overspending, set a monthly limit and wait 24 hours before any non-essential purchase.
Set a clear savings goal. If you save 5000 per month for 50000, you will finish in 10 months.
Check your subscriptions every month. Cancel the ones you no longer use.
Income is money you receive, like allowance, scholarship, or part-time earnings.
Expenses are what you spend. Track them to see where your money goes.
